description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing user session state within a React application, specifically for integrating Supabase authentication. It exports a React context, a provider component that fetches and updates session info, and a custom hook for accessing session data.

methods.name: SessionProvider({ children })
methods.description: A React component that provides session context to its children, managing authentication state via Supabase.

methods.name: useSession()
methods.description: A React hook that grants access to the session context (session data, user, loading state).

ctags.name: SessionCtx
ctags.pattern: /^const SessionCtx = createContext({ session: null, loading: true });$/
